collection.title: LEVC (Taxi) TX Electric Taxi 2017 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a LEVC TX 2017 Onwards model which requires a 23" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this LEVC TX which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
